subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this iMessage repair also fail closed for non-group, not-from-me direct messages whose sender still canonicalizes to destination_caller_id after attempted repair?
rationale: The repaired sender becomes the identity used for iMessage allowlist, pairing, session routing, and reply targeting, so repair-only versus drop-on-uncertain-repair is a security and delivery boundary choice.

options.title: Canonical Repair Plus Fail-Closed Guard
options.body: Repair confidently recovered peers with normalizeIMessageHandle and drop uncertain local-sender direct messages before access control.

options.title: Canonical Repair Only
options.body: Fix the normalization bug and require live proof while leaving uncertain cases to the existing downstream gates.

options.title: Pause Until Root Cause Is Clear
options.body: Hold or close this draft if the author's current failures are a different iMessage issue that needs a narrower fix.

recommendation.title: Canonical Repair Plus Fail-Closed Guard
recommendation.body: Repair confidently recovered peers with normalizeIMessageHandle and drop uncertain local-sender direct messages before access control.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent destination_caller_id and self-chat classification history in the same iMessage identity boundary.
